headline: S&P 500 and Dow Jones Slide as Oil Surges and AI Profitability Concerns Weigh
summary: Major US indices extended losses to conclude a negative week, pressured by rising crude oil prices and continuing investor skepticism around corporate AI returns.
why: The S&P 500 and Dow Jones benchmarks track the largest US companies, setting direction for global financial asset flows.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: Rising energy costs and doubts over technology earnings margins drive broad-based selling.

why_moved: Stocks fell on rising energy input costs and renewed skepticism regarding capital spending profitability in artificial intelligence.
